title: Design a power-loss-safe firmware update
description: Design a firmware update flow for an MCU with two image slots and power loss possible at any instruction. Describe image validation, boot metadata, the first boot of a new image, confirmation, and rollback. State your flash programming assumptions.
prompt: Design a firmware update flow for an MCU with two image slots and power loss possible at any instruction. Describe image validation, boot metadata, the first boot of a new image, confirmation, and rollback. State your flash programming assumptions.
constraints: State assumptions and separate measurements from guarantees.
rubric: Preserve a known bootable image until replacement is verified.
Distinguish corruption detection from image authenticity.
Make metadata updates recoverable and discuss failed trial boots.
follow_ups: How would you inject power failure during testing?
How does a monotonic anti-rollback counter complicate recovery?
hints: Write down the boundary cases before choosing an implementation.
Use explicit integer widths and keep intermediate values in range.
